official_definition: (Can't Stack: Nether Immortality) When your (Condition) "Nether" is destroyed, you can summon (deploy) this card from the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Nether Immortality] or [Nether Immortality: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Nether Immortality]", "give [Nether Immortality]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
